blockers.description: GSD defect 2 root cause not yet isolated. roadmap get-phase returns a bare {found:false} for every checklist-only phase in this repo's ROADMAP (53, 55, 56, 59, 60, 62) with no error/message/phase_name. Proven NOT to be the checklist regex (it matches raw content) and NOT the fallback logic (it fires correctly, message and all, on a minimal fixture). Cause is that 1.12.0 now searches extractCurrentMilestone(rawContent, cwd) and stripShippedMilestones(rawContent) instead of the raw file, and this repo's checklist entries (ROADMAP.md lines 29-441) do not survive that pass while the '### Phase N:' headings (line 458+) do.
